CustomField.description: FB-798: replaces Total_MRC__c (deleted was a Roll-Up Summary, which Salesforce does not allow converting to Currency in place). Apex-calculated (QuoteMrcRollupService, via QuoteLineItemTriggerHandler), ramp-phase aware see QuoteMrcRollupService for the calculation rules. Used in credit limit check and commission forecast.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Sum of recurring monthly charges across quote lines, ramp-phase aware. Auto-calculated from line items on every save - do not edit manually. Used for TCV calculation and credit limit validation.
CustomField.label: Total MRC (Quote)
